pending_commit.commit_message: CHROMIUM: ipu3-cio2: Improve vb2 buf queueing code Switched from infinite loop to finite loop, to check for the next unused FBPT entry. Errored out, when there is no unused FBPT entry available. Remove superflouous check for streaming status, since VB2 is responsible for calling .buf_queue() at the right time. This patch improves upon this patch. https://patchwork.kernel.org/patch/9833873/ BUG=b:66977756 TEST=Test WF & UF camera functionality on Soraka Change-Id: Ib8f2e3a9e4e092b643c4f8801cc5d902a0aaeddd Signed-off-by: Yong Zhi <yong.zhi@intel.com> Signed-off-by: Rajmohan Mani <rajmohan.mani@intel.com> Signed-off-by: Tianshu Qiu <tian.shu.qiu@intel.com> Signed-off-by: Tomasz Figa <tfiga@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/685600 Commit-Ready: Rajmohan Mani <rajmohan.mani@intel.corp-partner.google.com> Tested-by: Rajmohan Mani <rajmohan.mani@intel.corp-partner.google.com> Reviewed-by: Ricky Liang <jcliang@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: ipu3-cio2: Do not call vb2_plane_vaddr() Currently the driver calls vb2_plane_vaddr() just to use resulting address in a simple modulo division to figure out the offset in first page. In case of videobuf2-dma-sg, the mapping does not exist by default and calling the helper actually leads to a buffer map operation, which can be quite costly. Remove unnecessary cost by retrieving the offset from the first entry of sg_list in cio2_vb2_buf_init() and storing it in cio2_buffer struct, so that cio2_fbpt_entry_init_buf() can read it from there, without the need to invoke vb2 code anymore. BUG=b:66977756 TEST=Test WF & UF camera functionality on Lux Change-Id: I03d9a6f14e13650314590c5d453069d85f061245 Signed-off-by: Tomasz Figa <tfiga@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/686202 Commit-Ready: Rajmohan Mani <rajmohan.mani@intel.corp-partner.google.com> Tested-by: Rajmohan Mani <rajmohan.mani@intel.corp-partner.google.com> Reviewed-by: Ricky Liang <jcliang@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: ipu3-cio2: Disable interrupts during vb2 buf queueing This patch disables interrupts for the duration of vb2 buffer queueing. Code that could potentially sleep is moved outside the code path, in which interrupts are disabled Without this, the driver code that queues vb2 buf, could potentially be preempted for long duration, during which the CIO2 DMA engine might move further along processing more user buffers. When the DMA engine eventually runs into an FBPT entry that does not have VALID bit set, DMA engine would halt, which is undesired. BUG=b:66977756 TEST=Test WF & UF camera functionality on Soraka Change-Id: I36a886231c78aa50c52ea48f4615c7855f212b8d Signed-off-by: Rajmohan Mani <rajmohan.mani@intel.com> Signed-off-by: Tianshu Qiu <tian.shu.qiu@intel.com> Signed-off-by: Tomasz Figa <tfiga@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/685601 Commit-Ready: Rajmohan Mani <rajmohan.mani@intel.corp-partner.google.com> Tested-by: Rajmohan Mani <rajmohan.mani@intel.corp-partner.google.com> Reviewed-by: Ricky Liang <jcliang@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: drm/img-rogue: Do not mark DRM_POWERVR_ROGUE as BROKEN Commit 42a75bd16ec4 ("CHROMIUM: MALI: replace timeline fence with own fence implementation") made symbol sync_timeline_signal no longer EXPORTED. This broke compilation for the 1.7 versoin of drm/img-rogue. However, commit e9001eb10727 ("CHROMIUM: Mark DRM_POWERVR_ROGUE[_1_7] as BROKEN") marked both DRM_POWERVR_ROGUE and DRM_POWERVR_ROGUE_1_7. In truth DRM_POWERVR_ROGUE (the 1.8 driver) has its own internal definition of sync_timeline_signal, and was not actually broken. Furthermore, this is the preferred version of the driver. So, unmark it as BROKEN to get the IMG GPU driver building again on chromeos-4.4. Signed-off-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> BUG=b:64680718 TEST=Build and boot chromeos-4.4 on elm to UI Change-Id: I39373fa7fda432457ec38395c78d626a5e214b93 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/711388 Commit-Ready: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> Tested-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: config: mediatek: Re-enable CONFIG_DRM_POWERVR_ROGUE commit e9001eb10727 ("CHROMIUM: Mark DRM_POWERVR_ROGUE[_1_7] as BROKEN") had marked both DRM_POWERVR_ROGUE and DRM_POWERVR_ROGUE_1_7. A subsequent config renormalization by commit d588f325ce69 ("CHROMIUM: config: Renormalize config") had removed these configs. However, CONFIG_DRM_POWERVR_ROGUE had been incorrectly marked BROKEN (only CONFIG_DRM_POWERVR_ROGUE_1_7 was actually broken). Re-enable this config to allow building powerfvr for mediatek platforms. Signed-off-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> BUG=b:65433915 TEST=Build and boot elm to UI usage chromeos-4.4 Change-Id: I10ef6fd4f25128a573ce8e3993ce7b17bea6bb31 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/711389 Commit-Ready: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> Tested-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org>

intel-vaapi-driver: do not use media read with vpp Revert of upstream patch that uses media read instead of AVS for data reading at vpp. The upstream patch seek to fix a problem shown with jpeg encoding and high resolutions typically > 4K. This fixes a problem seen where decoding+vpp as measured by ChromeOS tools was higher than before. Using AVS again will not affect decoding+vpp time. chip/stm32/clock: Optionally use LSE as RTCCLK The default RTCCLK comes from LSI, which can vary from 30kHz to 60kHz. To use stm32 RTC for applications requiring accurate timing, let's setup LSE (a more accurate clock source) as RTCCLK. Also fix a typo in register.h as 'BCDR' should be 'BDCR' globally.
